Title: Direct URL to a Per-Org-Locked Rep's Own Profile Shows No Leak (Mirrors SR-GQL-017/024)
Section: Storefront > Sales Rep > Customer Profile > Scope
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
SR_REP_LOCKED's membership in @td(ORG_ACME.id) is per-org LOCKED. DOM-VERIFIED (2026-07-17, theme pr-2383): the rep is BLOCKED AT SIGN-IN ITSELF — attempting to authenticate returns HTTP 400 on /connect/token with the message "Your access to this organization has been blocked" — the rep never obtains a session at all, so {{locked_org}}'s profile is unreachable by construction. This is the STRONGEST possible no-leak proof available (no session exists to even attempt the leak with), stronger than SR-CP-004's genuinely-unserved-org case. FIXTURE GAP: the originally-planned STR (sign in via the active @td(ORG_TECHFLOW.id) context, then navigate directly to the locked org's profile URL, mirroring 050m SR-GQL-017/024's per-org-lock-vs-full-account-block distinction) could NOT be exercised — this fixture has no reachable ACTIVE alternate org in the current environment to sign in through instead. Flagging for a future fixture fix (a rep locked in one org but genuinely active/reachable in another) so the per-org-scoping semantic can also be verified, not just the account-level sign-in block.
Corrected: 2026-09-07 (REG-2026-09-07-1342 live regression, cross-referenced against REG-2026-09-02-2055) -- the account-level sign-in block this case originally pinned no longer holds. Per BL-AUTH-016 (amended 2026-08-04/2026-08-05; source: vc-module-customer OrganizationIdRequestValidator.cs ValidateOrganizationAccessAsync, allowFallback branch), a per-org lock on a password-grant sign-in now falls back silently to an accessible served org (HTTP 200, no error) instead of refusing the whole account, whenever an accessible org exists -- this is deliberate, not a defect. This CLOSES the FIXTURE GAP the case originally documented ("no reachable ACTIVE alternate org to sign in through instead"): SR_REP_LOCKED's TechFlow membership IS that alternate org, so the originally-planned STR (sign in via the active org, then navigate directly to the locked org's profile URL, mirroring the same per-org-lock-vs-full-account-block distinction referenced above) is now directly executable and is what this case does below. Live-confirmed this session: sign-in succeeds (200) as "Lena Park", the session pins to the unlocked TechFlow org, My customers lists TechFlow only (ACME excluded), and a direct hit on ACME's profile URL renders a graceful not-found with no org name/address/contact/order data leaked. Fixture state independently cross-checked via the Platform API (organization-memberships/search): the ACME membership is isLocked=true, the TechFlow membership is isLocked=false, and the account's global lockoutEnd is null -- the lock is scoped to the one org, not the account. Docs axis: N/A -- auth-flow implementation detail, no published guide covers /connect/token org-fallback behavior.
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] salesRepCustomer(organizationId: {{locked_org}}) resolves null/not-found for SR_REP_LOCKED, errors[] empty, mirroring 050m SR-GQL-017/024's per-org-lock-vs-full-account-block distinction
[API] Platform API organization-memberships/search confirms @td(ORG_ACME.id)'s membership isLocked=true while @td(ORG_TECHFLOW.id)'s is isLocked=false and the account's global lockoutEnd is null -- the block is scoped to the one org, not the account
Failure_Signals: sign-in is refused (non-200) despite an accessible served org existing; the session's active organization resolves to the LOCKED org instead of the accessible one; the locked org's real name/address/contact/orders render on direct navigation (a data leak); a raw error page/stack trace replaces the graceful not-found state
Cleanup: none (read-only) — no session was ever established
References: VCST-5308, VCST-5293, DOM-verified vcst-qa theme 2.54.0-pr-2383, TLC-2026-07-17-1200; Corrected: 2026-09-07 (REG-2026-09-07-1342 triage, cross-referenced REG-2026-09-02-2055) -- sign-in outcome and STR rewritten per BL-AUTH-016 (amended 2026-08-04/2026-08-05); Source: vc-module-customer/OrganizationIdRequestValidator.cs ValidateOrganizationAccessAsync (allowFallback branch); Docs: N/A -- auth-flow implementation detail, no published guide covers /connect/token org-fallback behavior | Behavior:sr.scope.locked-membership

Title: Coupons — the Expires date a rep reads is never after the last day the code works

The sales-rep plugin and the Marketing module are installed, so the 'Available coupons' block is registered and the coupons route exists. Needs a coupon whose end, in the BROWSER's zone, is exactly 00:00:00 -- the instant at which the date shown and the last working day come apart. Record BROWSER_OFFSET_H from the lane first (new Date().getTimezoneOffset()/-60); the case needs a zone other than UTC. Discover the coupon from the rep API (a listed item whose endDate falls on a whole local midnight, for example a code ending at 22:00Z in a UTC+2 browser); if none exists record BLOCKED:CONDITION_NOT_MET naming the zone.
